text: Zacharias hears the soft beating of any mortal heart from miles away, eagerly sucking the life essence from it's core.
Its jewel invokes the protection of the gods of lost Nehekhara on the bearer. Its power swells with every death nearby.

A pall of Mortis clings to the Everliving, the cold breath of a death he has cheated for centuries. The living who come near feel their strength fail and their courage wither, and the more of them crowd around him, the deeper it bites. Living enemies only: Undead and Daemonic units are unaffected.
